text:
Ethan: Hey finance — weird one. I used the Redwood virtual card for my hotel stay in Chicago but the virtual card expired the morning of checkout. Front desk charged my personal card for a $65 incidentals hold and then billed a $42 minibar charge after checkout. I never used the minibar. Hotel says it's their policy. Can I still get reimbursed and how do we dispute the charge?

Expense-bot: Hi Ethan — keypad: personal charges related to business travel can be reimbursed if supported by manager approval + vendor folio showing charge. For disputed charges we need the hotel folio, a signed checkout receipt, and any front desk notes. If you want us to pursue a dispute with the vendor, open a cards dispute request here: https://redwood.finance/cards/dispute. Note disputes against personal cards require employee consent.

Ethan: Uploaded my bank txn screenshot and an email from FrontDesk saying the charge posted on 2026-04-18. I don't have a signed folio; they said they'd email it. TEMP LINK: https://files.redwood/ethan-bank-42.png and https://files.redwood/hotel-email. Submitted expense as EXP-7552 under TR-2026 for the full $107 (hold + minibar).

Marta: I approve reimbursement for lodging incidentals related to client travel. Marta approved 2026-04-19. However approve only after Finance confirms dispute outcome. Put "Client: CHI onboarding 2026-04-17 to 2026-04-18" in the Concur note.

AP: Finance/AP here — to process any reimbursement we need the hotel folio (itemized), the front desk signed checkout slip if available, and proof you attempted to resolve with the hotel (email or ticket). If the hotel later issues a refund for the $42 minibar we will not reimburse it. For now we can tentatively hold EXP-7552 pending folio.

Ethan: Got it. I called the hotel and the manager (FrontDesk) said they'd escalate and send the itemized folio and a note that minibar charge was a "system error" if refunded. I forwarded the email to finance@redwood and attached it to EXP-7552.

FrontDesk: Hello Ethan & Finance — this is FrontDesk from Lakeview Suites. We investigated and found the minibar item posted to the wrong room in our PMS. We will issue a refund of $42 to the card on file within 5-7 business days and send an itemized folio showing the correction. Apologies for the inconvenience. Reference: SR-4476.

Expense-bot: EXP-7552 updated: status "pending vendor refund". Note: if refund posts to your personal card, Finance will not reimburse that amount. If refund does not post within 10 business days, Finance can consider reimbursing the net charged amount subject to manager approval and a signed Lost Receipt/Dispute form.

Ethan: Thanks for the update. If refund doesn't show by next Thursday I'll request the dispute form.

AP: We'll hold EXP-7552 in pending status and monitor. Ethan, please upload any refund confirmation email or bank reversal screenshot. If no refund and hotel cannot provide folio, we may require a signed Lost Receipt / Dispute Attestation form.

Marta: Thanks for handling this. Ethan — good call to follow up. If Finance needs any additional approval from me, ping here.

FrontDesk: Refund issued (SR-4476) — reversal posted 2026-04-23, reference REV-9921. Itemized folio attached in follow-up email.

Ethan: Uploaded bank reversal screenshot and the corrected folio to EXP-7552. Looks like the $42 refund hit my account on 2026-04-23.

Expense-bot: EXP-7552 status: "cleared". Finance notes: $42 refunded to employee; hold of $65 for incidentals remains unpaid by hotel and is eligible for reimbursement with folio and manager approval. Reimbursement scheduled for $65 net to employee. Expect payout in 3 business days.

AP: Processed payment for $65 to Ethan. Payment reference AP-2026-159. Closing item.

Ethan: Received payment. Thanks everyone for the quick help and for resolving with the hotel. :thumbsup:
